The **2023–24 Bundesliga** was the 61st season of the Bundesliga, Germany's premier football competition. On 14 April 2024, Bayer Leverkusen were crowned champions for the first time with five matches to spare following a 5–0 win over Werder Bremen, becoming the thirteenth different champion in Bundesliga history and ending previous holders Bayern Munich's run of eleven consecutive titles. | Union Berlin | 1–1 | — | 3–4 | 2–1 | 1–0 | 0–2 | 0–3 | 2–1 | 2–2 | 0–2 | 2–0 | 0–3 | 0–1 | 4–1 | 3–1 | 1–5 | 0–3 | 1–0 |. | Borussia Dortmund | 5–1 | 4–2 | 3–1 | 1–0 | 4–0 | — | 3–1 | 3–0 | 2–2 | 2–3 | 1–0 | 2–3 | 1–1 | 1–1 | 4–2 | 0–4 | 0–1 | 1–0 |.
